trial_court: Principal Judge Family Court, Dehradun (Original Suit No. 694 of 2020)
case_name: Smt. Deepshikha Purohit vs Shri Pursotam Purohit
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between husband and wife with two young children; prayer for transferring proceedings to Principal Judge Family Court, Rudraprayag.

legal_principles.principle: Parties should be willing to resolve disputes amicably and discharge their matrimonial obligations.
legal_principles.held: The parties voluntarily agreed that they are willing to live together peacefully and to discharge their matrimonial obligation together.

legal_principles.principle: A party's apprehension about financial security should be addressed in a settlement.
legal_principles.held: She expresses her willingness to give away her job, in which, she is presently engaged on daily wage basis, but the only apprehension, which she had was that she may be financially deprived of the financial assistance, which had been otherwise provided to her by the orders passed in the proceedings under Section 125 and under the Domestic Violence Act.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005 — Section 125

outcome.final_order: Matter directed to be placed before the Mediator (Registrar, Inspection) for mediation; amicable settlement failed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court proceedings
